acceptanceCriteria: A: finalization action and error categories come from typed observed facts rather than English error-string matching; retained, missing, corrupt, identity-mismatch, cleanup-pending, and unknown cases provide correct safe next actions.

B: one request-scoped observation boundary records every required file and directory candidate dependency, including events and archive candidates, detects replacement/addition/deletion/type drift, and returns unknown after bounded instability.

C: collaboration scenario matrix executes real CLI and MCP paths across summary/full and en/zh-CN/ja, verifies blockers, authorization, unknowns, and action semantics, and proves manual fixture expectations cannot mask endpoint defects.

D: performance traces bind operation, scenario, measurement, runtime identity, phase parentage, and counters to actual boundaries; benchmark separates probes/metadata/processes, uses at least 100 valid warm samples, and reports p50/p95 only with sufficient evidence.

E: each optimization is independently measurable and committable, is retained only when correctness gates pass and the measured bottleneck improves without unacceptable regression, and no unmeasured candidate is presented as a benefit.
All required Rust, matrix, performance, documentation, governance, release, installation, and upgrade checks pass from the reviewed branch; historical bytes remain unchanged.
A new immutable version is discovered after v0.2.90, published from the reviewed merge, and its downloaded artifact passes isolated install and N-1 upgrade acceptance.
The Work Item follows start, preflight, checkpoint, verify, finish, archive, reviewed PR, merge, close, documentation promotion, synchronization, and exact cleanup with current Runtime evidence.

P0 release isolation scanning is implemented by one Rust process for enumeration, metadata, streaming hashes, and deterministic manifest output, with compatible result/exit/output semantics and special-path, symlink, and cross-platform coverage; the 80% target is reported honestly if not met.

P0 release installation and N-1 upgrade acceptance share Rust logic for artifact identity, isolated roots, steps, failure reports, cleanup, and phase-bound retry; candidate fresh install and candidate upgrade, then public fresh install, public upgrade, and version consistency checks run in independent isolation with required joins.

P1 governance, documentation, parity, and archive-reference checks use shared Rust rules and request-local facts where they are production paths; offline statistics, independent black-box tests, one-time maintenance tools, bootstrap, and platform glue remain explicitly classified.

WI execution reuses Contract/config/policy/receipt facts within one operation, reads only target dependencies unless a global governance fact is required, checks cheap deterministic prerequisites before expensive verification, stops dependent work after prerequisite failure, and emits structured retry/failure records without creating a successor for every technical retry.

At least three WI scenarios (no source change, single-file change, cross-module change) are measured in Cockpit and at least one verified current object engineering project; Cockpit management, engineering verification, external waiting, and failure-rework costs remain separately identified, with object-project source changes out of scope unless separately authorized.

Every release phase has identity-bound resumable evidence; injected interruption, timeout, cleanup failure, network/runner failure, and identity mismatch prove that recovery reuses valid phases, does not rebuild or republish unnecessarily, does not overwrite Release/tag/history, and blocks on inconsistent public artifacts.
用户可见收益：在保持事实、授权和兼容性边界的前提下，完整 WI 与发布执行链的等待时间缩短，失败恢复少重复执行；收益以 Cockpit 与对象工程测量、发布阶段计时及恢复复用证据为准，不由实现本身推断。

公开安装与 N-1 升级验收必须消费 publish_handoff 生成的 identity-bound receipt；receipt 必须由 Rust release helper 校验 request identity、provider Release ID、tag、commit、manifest 摘要、Formula 摘要和有效期，并将 handoff 摘要纳入 public phase identity。
